summary: NutriBand Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to a $5,000,000 credit line facility dated June 1, 2026, replacing an existing facility expiring July 13, 2026. The three-year line carries 7% interest, with no conversion rights. It funds FDA approval and commercial manufacturing for AVERSA Fentanyl. The filing is a routine material definitive agreement, not a special situation.
